node.title: Rate-half far-CA rider and doubly sparse reduction
node.statement: For every linear code at integer radius r<n/2, the far-pair correlated-agreement numerator obeys B_ca^far(n-r)<=1+(r+1)L_2(n-2r). If a column-far pair has at least two bad slopes, translation by a code pair normalizes both received components to 2r-sparse errors. At rate one half and agreement a=k+tau, the deficient pair-list agreement is n-2r=2tau. This is a structural reduction and does not assert that its sufficient prize inequality holds.
